name: Usai
title: Father of Hananiah, a wall builder in Jerusalem
summary: Usai is known from the book of Nehemiah as the father of Hananiah, who participated in rebuilding the walls of Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile. He is mentioned only briefly in the Bible, but his son played an important role in the restoration work under Nehemiah's leadership.

keyEvents.title: Rebuilding of Jerusalem's Walls
keyEvents.description: Usai's son Hananiah took part in rebuilding the walls of Jerusalem. Hananiah was a perfumer by trade and helped repair a section of the wall.

keyEvents.title: Nehemiah's Wall-Building Project
keyEvents.description: Under Nehemiah's leadership, the walls of Jerusalem were rebuilt by various families and occupational groups. Usai's family was among those who contributed to this important work.

keyEvents.title: Opposition to the Rebuilding
keyEvents.description: The wall builders, including Hananiah son of Usai, faced opposition from enemies such as Sanballat and Tobiah, but continued their work faithfully.

keyEvents.title: Completion of the Wall
keyEvents.description: Despite opposition, the walls of Jerusalem were completed in 52 days, a task to which Usai's son also contributed.
